stage.description: Current research stage you're working on.

sub_questions.description: List of sub-questions you've identified (for planning stage).

sources_count.description: Number of sources found (for source finding stage context).

gaps.description: List of gaps or limitations identified (for review stage).

additional_context.description: Extra guidance or constraints for the research.

search_query.description: Optional search query to perform web search using DuckDuckGo. If provided, the tool will search and return results.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default: 5, max: 10).
